topic: Myth: mining ends when the 21 million cap hits
hook: Myth: when the last bitcoin is issued, mining stops.

scenes.narration: The block subsidy is expected to reach zero around the year twenty one forty.
After that, miners are paid only by transaction fees.
How well fees alone will secure the network is an open question. Nobody has tested it at scale.

cta: What do you think happens then? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Myth: Bitcoin Mining Stops at 21 Million
description_body: After the subsidy ends around 2140, miners earn only transaction fees.
